verdict.rationale: Snyk is a SaaS platform that processes customer code with AI features such as DeepCode AI, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of model training. The Broker's token-isolation docs and a community-quoted content license clause concern different subjects, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
